test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If an investment earns straight interest at the rate of 4% per annum, how many years will it take for the investment to double?
solution:
**Given:**

The rate of interest is 4% and

the money will double at the end.

**Concept Used:**

SI = {Ptimes Rtimes Tover100},

A = P + SI

SI = Simple interest, P = Principal, A = Amount, R = rate, T = time
